<b>{{PAGENAME}}</b> was introduced in [[Game of Crone]] DLC. It can hold 9 items in it, effectively increasing your inventory size. There is also bigger version of it: [[Big universal bag]].
You cannot put one bag inside another bag. One bag and [[Universal Bag Recipe|recipe]] for it is rewarded upon completing about 75% of the [[Refugee camp|refugee camp]] quest line with [[Marquis Teodoro Jr.]]
